metadata.question: Did the coastal city of La Serena experience at least 6cm of rainfall in July 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: La Serena is a coastal city in Chile (approximately -29.9°, -71.25°) - Time: July 2022 (2022-07-01 to 2022-07-31) - Collection: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) for rainfall data - CHIRPS provides daily precipitation in mm 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for CHIRPS (it's already processed precipitation data) - Need to sum precipitation over the month 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Total precipitation < 60mm (6cm) = Answer B - >= 60mm = Answer A - If no images found = C1 - If calculation returns null/undefined = C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const laSerena = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.25, -29.9]); const startDate = '2022-07-01'; const endDate = '2022-07-31'; console.log('Analyzing rainfall in La Serena, Chile for July 2022'); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const precipitation = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(laSerena); const collectionSize = precipitation.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No precipitation data available for the specified period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum all daily precipitation const totalPrecip = precipitation.sum(); // 4. Calculation - Get total precipitation at point const result = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: laSerena, scale: 5566, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const totalRainfall = result.getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (totalRainfall === null || totalRainfall === undefined || isNaN(totalRainfall)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Total rainfall in July 2022: ${totalRainfall.toFixed(2)} mm (${(totalRainfall/10).toFixed(2)} cm)`); const thresholdMm = 60; // 6cm = 60mm if (totalRainfall >= thresholdMm) { console.log(`Rainfall (${totalRainfall.toFixed(2)} mm) >= 60 mm threshold`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`Rainfall (${totalRainfall.toFixed(2)} mm) < 60 mm threshold`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
